info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Healthcare Appointments API facilitates the timely cancellation of scheduled healthcare appointments. This endpoint allows users to manage appointment statuses effectively, ensuring resources are optimally allocated and patients' schedules are updated. Ideal for healthcare providers and administrative personnel, this API streamlines the cancellation process, thereby improving operational efficiency. With support for batch operations, it allows for multiple cancellations in a single request, catering to diverse use cases in the healthcare environment.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a previously scheduled appointment. Make sure to provide the required appointment ID to successfully process the cancellation request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing appointment. It includes essential details necessary for identifying the appointment to be canceled.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.title: Cancel Appointment Request Body
DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling an appointment operation. It is expected to contain a string value indicating the details of the cancellation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.title: Appointment Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the cancellation.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the appointment after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing details about the cancellation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for a successful appointment cancellation operation.
